pages.title: Xenorhinotherium
pages.text: The Xenorhinotherium ($(o)Xenorhinotherium bahiense$()) is an extinct litoptern that lived in the tropical lowlands of northeastern Brazil and Venezuela during the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)A close relative of Macrauchenia, it shared the same long neck, long legs and three-toed feet.$(br2)Its name means "strange-nosed beast", after its nasal opening, which sat far back on top of the skull rather than at the tip of the snout.
